consequence.statement: The golang image digest used under /e2e (end-to-end tests) was bumped by dependabot. Nothing in the evidence indicates an operational effect on deployed installations.

original.statement: In external-secrets 0.16.0, the golang image used in the /e2e test directory was bumped from digest 75e6700 to 00eccd4. This is a dependabot dependency chore.

decision.reason: [ev-f40760384829] shows this is a dependabot bump of the golang digest in the repository's /e2e (end-to-end test) directory. It names no runtime, chart or API surface that an operator uses. The validators back this up: golang is not referenced in either release's manifests and does not appear in the rendered output. The "BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed" locator is a section heading for the whole list, not a statement about this item. So a consequence of "none" with an informational class fits, but I rate confidence low because "none" is inferred from the /e2e scope rather than stated outright.
